description: We are beginners wanting to level up our skills.
summary: Cosmic Echo is an interactive NASA Space Apps 2026 web app for the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge that lets users explore the universe and hunt for hidden objects using NASA's 102-channel infrared survey through five hands-on tools: an Interactive Sky Map, Cosmic Timeline, visible-to-infrared Spectrum Lab, SPHEREx Mission Data Portal, and a Planet X Hunter blink comparator for spotting moving trans-Neptunian bodies.
details: Cosmic Echo is a React single-page web app styled with Tailwind CSS and deployed via GitHub and Vercel. It uses interactive canvas/HTML5 rendering for sky navigation and multi-epoch image blinking, while integrating NASA's SPHEREx 102-channel infrared survey datasets and multi-wavelength overlays into a fast, client-side observatory
